stage14_4af.role: canonical Pythagorean-base E_t family; generic geometric rank zero; exact torsion Z/2 x Z/4 on genuine rational Pythagorean bases

physical_base_reparameterization.retained_open: rational physical v gives p,q nonzero and not +/-1

birational_adapter.inverse_denominator_X_eq_c: E_q RHS at X=c is -((p^2-1)(p^2+1)/(4p^3))^2, so no rational E_q point has X=c
birational_adapter.quartic_points_at_infinity: not rational because the scaled quartic has leading coefficient -1

torsion_exclusion_on_physical_endpoint.two_torsion: all E_q 2-torsion corresponds to z^2 in {p^2,p^(-2)} and is excluded by physical U
torsion_exclusion_on_physical_endpoint.stage14_full_torsion: Z/2 x Z/4, so the above exhausts all rational torsion
torsion_exclusion_on_physical_endpoint.conclusion: every physical endpoint maps to a non-torsion E_q(Q) point

rank_jump_receiver.stage14_pythagorean_surface: elliptic K3 with I4^6 and trivial lattice rank 20
rank_jump_receiver.endpoint_consequence: a physical endpoint forces a rational Pythagorean base q whose specialized E_q has positive Mordell-Weil rank
rank_jump_receiver.equivalently: physical endpoint lies over a rank-jump specialization of a generic-rank-zero Pythagorean-base elliptic K3 family
